incidents-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 2039043210 — Elevated tail latency detected in preproc-service (p99 > 2.8s). Streaming sessions reporting stalls. Alert: preproc-template-latency > threshold. Paging oncall: @sara

sara (oncall): ack. I’m oncall and looking. @matt can you join, this smells like template/parse work in preproc.

matt (eng-runtime): joining. Initial ask: any customer-facing errors or timeouts? which routes?

olivia (customer-success): FYI — we’ve got 3 customers reporting streaming stalls (one enterprise, one mid-market). Tickets: CS-4521 (enterprise), CS-4522, CS-4523. Enterprise reports 5–7 minute degraded sessions, audio/video unaffected, generative responses stalled mid-stream.

sara (oncall): thanks. grabbing logs now. quick TL;DR metrics: p50 ~110ms, p95 ~420ms, p99 ~2.9s for preproc-template path. Streaming tail latency spike correlated with high template expansion & JSON-mode parsing.

matt (eng-runtime): logs? paste top sample lines pls.

sara (oncall): pasted log snip:
```
[preproc] 2026-03-15T14:00:22Z ERROR parse_template req_id=abc123 schema_expand=1370ms templates=3 mode=json_mode
[preproc] 2026-03-15T14:00:23Z WARN tokenizer req_id=abc124 tokenize_time=950ms tokens=1200 streaming=true
[preproc] 2026-03-15T14:00:24Z INFO request_flow req_id=abc123 route=streaming template_ops=sync
```

matt (eng-runtime): okay this matches a known hotspot — when tool schemas are expanded synchronously under json_mode we block the streaming pipeline while parsing + validating. If multiple big tool schemas or large prompt templates hit at once, CPU + GC spike => tail latency.

raj: I’m free, can take runtime remediation after handoff.

matt (eng-runtime): mitigation plan (short):
1) flip json_mode=false for streaming route (fast feature-flag rollback)
2) divert streaming traffic to preproc-dedicated pool (if needed)
3) throttle template expansion with worker queue (medium term)
4) postmortem + optimize schema expansion async

sara (oncall): prioritize 1 and 2 now. who can flip the flag?

alex (devex): I can run ops command. proposed command:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://config.internal/api/v1/flags \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
 -d '{"service":"preproc","flag":"json_mode","value":false,"scope":"route:streaming"}'
```

ops-bot: Executing config change (dry-run check passed).

ops-bot: Change applied at 2026-03-15T14:04:12Z by alex (devex): preproc.json_mode=false (scope=route:streaming).

incidents-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation step recorded — feature-flag flip. Monitoring for impact.

matt (eng-runtime): monitoring: start. watch p99 and streaming stalls. also consider reducing template validation strictness for now (skip optional checks).

sara (oncall): immediate metrics after flip (14:06): p99 dropped from 2.9s -> 370ms, p95 -> 150ms. streaming stall counts down 85% within 2 minutes.

ops-bot: Telemetry snapshot:
- preproc p50=115ms p95=148ms p99=372ms
- streaming-stalls last5m=4 (was 27)
- CPU usage on preproc-nodes decreased 45%

olivia (customer-success): passing to CS — telling enterprise customer that mitigation applied, will follow up in 30m. they asked for RCA and ETA for permanent fix.

matt (eng-runtime): medium-term actions: async schema expansion + caching for common tool schemas, move heavy tokenization off hot path (background tokenization), add guardrails for template size and token count for streaming. I’ll open RFC and link evals.

alex (devex): logging note — add new span tags: template_size, schema_nodes_count, parse_sync_time. helps for future triage.

sara (oncall): handing active incident to raj for follow-up and postmortem owner assignment. raj, can you take over? I’ll be offline in ~30m.

raj: taking it. setting incident status Sev2 -> active. I’ll coordinate postmortem and RCA. tagging alex + matt + olivia as owners.

ops-bot: Incident update: severity=Sev2, mitigated=true (json_mode disabled for streaming), impact=degraded streaming for ~12 mins, customers affected=3, customers with sustained impact=1.

olivia (customer-success): CS will send an interim message to affected customers and offer a call with eng if they want deeper details.

alex (devex): created follow-up ticket INF-981: "async schema expansion + template caching" and INF-982: "add guardrails for streaming template token count".

matt (eng-runtime): temporary workaround: for next 24h we’ll keep json_mode off for streaming; enable a canary for non-streaming routes to verify performance before re-enabling.

raj: thanks all. assign postmortem owner = alex (devex) for writeup, target doc by EOD + action items for next sprint. closing active hands but keeping incident thread open for notes. :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: Incident 2039043210 — mitigation applied, handoff complete. Thread will be used for RCA and follow-ups.
